messages.subject: RHipe 0.73.1 : rhinit() problem
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I installed RHipe 0.73.1  over CDH3.
When I run rhinit(), I get following error:

> rhinit()
Rhipe: Using Rhipe.jar file
Initializing Rhipe v0.73
Initializing mapfile caches
Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod", cl,  :
  java.lang.IncompatibleClassChangeError: class com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder$3 has interface com.google.common.base.Ticker as super class

Please help, what could be  the problem?

messages.subject: Reading sequence files in RHipe
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I want to run a map reduce job which takes sequence file as input. Values in sequence file are of type "TypedBytesWritable". It fails with the following error

Caused by : java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.apache.hadoop.typedbytes.TypedBytesWritable

Any idea how to handle this? How do I make RHipe load hadoop-streaming.jar? Please help.

Regards,
Anand

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Reading sequence files in RHipe
messages.body_plain:
you'd need a wrapper. Look at

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/java/org/godhuli/rhipe/RXSQTextAndTextIF.java

And then write a wrapper for seqence files with whose keys(and presumably values?) are of org.apache.hadoop.typedbytes.TypedBytesWritable

It's not too difficult.
